categories.name: Brakes
categories.description: A matched front/rear brake and pad set. Better heat tolerance can matter more than a single hard stop.

categories.name: Suspension
categories.description: A matched front/rear spring and damper set. Fitting restores suspension and alignment setup. Race hardware adds controls; stiffer is not always faster on city streets.

categories.name: Differentials
categories.description: Differentials for the car's existing driven axles. Keeps the base build's final-drive and gearbox hardware and drive layout. Supported ratio adjustments retain their saved setup.

categories.name: Wheels & tyres
categories.description: A complete front/rear rim and tyre set for the build's existing hubs. Choose a look and tyre setup; larger wheels are not automatically faster.

categories.name: Engine kits
categories.description: Matched native intake, ECU, internals, exhaust and cooling for this engine. Keeps the engine block and drivetrain; race electronics add tuning where supported.

engineDonors.name: Factory GTz turbo kit
engineDonors.description: Factory turbo induction, strengthened internals, sport ECU and exhaust, heavy-duty mounts and race radiator for the original 1.5L DOHC engine. Boost remains the native fixed setting.

engineDonors.name: Stage 1 street turbo kit
engineDonors.description: Stage 1 turbo, Evolution ECU, Stage 1 internals, pod filter, custom exhaust and matched cooling from the native street build. Keeps the original 1.5L DOHC engine and transmission.

wheelAlternatives.name: Okudai RZ4 · 15-inch
wheelAlternatives.description: White RZ4 rims with the Pro preset's matched 195/50 R15 race tyres. A different look on the same rim dimensions; no engine package required.

wheelAlternatives.name: Okudai PR01 · 15-inch
wheelAlternatives.description: White PR01 rims with the Street preset's matched 195/60 R15 sport tyres. Fits the original four-lug hubs.

wheelAlternatives.name: Okudai RZ4 · 15-inch
wheelAlternatives.description: White RZ4 rims with 195/60 R15 sport tyres from the Street preset. Fits the four-lug stock and Street builds.

wheelAlternatives.name: Ibishu Type-VX · 17-inch
wheelAlternatives.description: Silver Type-VX rims with the Street preset's 215/45 R17 sport tyres. A period street look on the existing five-lug hubs.

wheelAlternatives.name: ETK Aero-5 · 16-inch
wheelAlternatives.description: Aero-5 rims with the Street preset's 205/50 R16 sport tyres. Keeps the five-lug hubs and engine setup.
